personality_one_liner: A trustworthy, calm, and distinctly civic digital queue manager that respects the user's time without feeling like a bank or a pager.

spacing.rule: Strict 8pt grid. Generous padding around content to reduce cognitive load. Avoid desktop layouts squeezed onto phones.

do's: Use simple surface elevations and drop shadows to establish hierarchy.
dont's: Do not use glassmorphism, blurs, or excessive gradients as requested in constraints.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Educate users about the benefits of virtual queuing and capture necessary permissions.
screens.layout: Full-screen slides with top-aligned illustration/image, H1 at bottom 1/3, short paragraph, and sticky primary button at the bottom.

states.loading: Centered spinner with text 'Preparing your experience...'

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Provide immediate access to the user's active queue status and entry points for services.
screens.layout: Dynamic dashboard. If active ticket exists, show oversized 'Active Ticket' card at top with Ticket # (4xl), status timeline, ETA, people ahead, and verification code. Below: Quick actions (Join Line, Find Branch) in a 2-column grid.

states.loading: Skeleton of the active ticket card and grid.
states.empty: Illustration of a calm waiting area. Text: 'You have no active queues.' Button: 'Find a Service'.
states.error: Card showing 'Unable to load queue status.' with Retry button.

screens.name: Find a Branch
screens.purpose: List nearby or relevant public service branches without a map view.
screens.layout: Sticky search/filter header. Scrollable list of cards displaying Branch Name (e.g., 'Half Way Tree'), distance, open/closed status chip, and live wait time. No map.

states.empty: Icon + 'No branches match your filters.' + 'Clear Filters' button.

screens.name: Branch Details
screens.purpose: Show comprehensive details about a specific branch and its services.
screens.layout: Hero image of the branch. Below: title, hours, accessibility icons. Then a list of available services (e.g., 'TRN Registration') with live wait times next to each.

states.loading: Skeleton of hero image and content lines.
states.error: Error loading branch details + Retry button.

screens.name: Join-a-Line Flow
screens.purpose: Multi-step process to secure a spot in a virtual line.
screens.layout: Step-by-step wizard. Service -> Branch -> Review -> Confirm. Sticky 'Continue' bottom button. Progress bar at the top.

states.error: Queue full or closed error state.

screens.name: Live Ticket
screens.purpose: Real-time monitoring of queue status, position, and check-in readiness.
screens.layout: Hero layout with oversized ticket number (e.g., 'A045'). Status timeline (stepper). Dynamic states for 'ready-to-check-in' (reveals check-in QR/Code) and 'delayed' (coral warning chip).

states.error: Connection lost warning bar + offline mode.

screens.name: Called-to-window
screens.purpose: High-urgency state when it's the user's turn.
screens.layout: Full-screen modal/sheet. Massive window number (e.g., 'Window TRN-3'). 5-min countdown timer pulsing. 6-digit verification code prominent.

screens.name: Sessions list
screens.layout: Segmented tabs (Upcoming/Past). List of session cards with QR/Alphanumeric codes.

states.error: Failed to load sessions + Retry button.

Buttons.Primary: Solid brandPrimary (Royal Blue), rounded-lg (16px), onBrandPrimary text.
Buttons.Secondary: Solid brandSecondary (Soft Blue), rounded-lg (16px), onBrandSecondary (Royal Blue) text.
Buttons.Tertiary: Transparent background, brandPrimary text, no border.

components.Cards: Solid surfaceSecondary (White), border radius 16px to 20px, subtle shadow tier 1. Set on surface (Pale blue-grey) background.
components.StatusChips: Always Icon + Text. Example: [Clock Icon] 15m wait. [Check Icon] Active. Never color alone.
components.TicketNumber: Centered, oversized text (3xl to 4xl), Plus Jakarta Sans bold.
components.ProgressBar: brandPrimary fill over surfaceTertiary track, rounded edges.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the specific colors in the 'color' block. Deep navy (#0B192C) is the primary base, Royal blue (#1D4ED8) is for active states, Pale blue-grey (#F0F4F8) is the main background with white cards.
Do NOT use glassmorphism or blurs. Maintain a flat, civic, accessible UI with subtle shadows.
Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for all text, conveying a friendly yet confident tone.
Never communicate status purely through color. Always pair a status color (coral for warning, green for success) with a recognizable Feather icon and text label.
Make sure touch targets are large (minimum 44x44pt) to accommodate accessibility standards.
On the Home and Live Ticket screens, ensure the Ticket Number is massive (48pt to 64pt).
Use Jamaican realistic content for mock data (Names: Kemar, Shanice; Branches: Half Way Tree, Constant Spring; Services: TRN Registration).
